title: Let the body learn surrender first
summary: Devotion becomes real when the body enters surrender. Serve in a way that leaves the self quieter.
takeaway: Serve in a way that leaves the self quieter.
lifeApplication: When service starts bargaining for notice, return it to hidden love and steady hands.

source.shortMeaning: Devotion becomes real when the body enters surrender.
source.lifeApplication: When ego starts negotiating, bow physically before you let it speak.

evidence.coreClaim: Devotion becomes real when the body enters surrender.
evidence.turn: Keep this in front of you: let surrender reach the body before the ego performs again.
evidence.practicalImplication: When service starts bargaining for notice, return it to hidden love and steady hands.
